business_summary.text: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited is a leading producer of ferrochrome with integrated operations including captive chrome ore mines and manufacturing facilities.

lab.quote: In Q1, we will be looking at about 80,000 tons because of the additional output from KNR 2, which is coming in.

call_memory.quote: In Q1, we will be looking at about 80,000 tons because of the additional output from KNR 2, which is coming in.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Ferrochrome sales volume is expected to be about 80,000 tons in Q1 FY27, up from the normal 65,000 to 67,000 tons due to KNR 2 output.

lab.quote: Secondly, as far as our strategy for Kalinganagar 1 and 2 is concerned, our output is going to go from about 265,000 tons, which is where we are in FY '26 to broadly 400,000 tons in FY '27 and 500,000 tons or so, 475,000 to 500,000 tons in FY '28.

call_memory.quote: Secondly, as far as our strategy for Kalinganagar 1 and 2 is concerned, our output is going to go from about 265,000 tons, which is where we are in FY '26 to broadly 400,000 tons in FY '27 and 500,000 tons or so, 475,000 to 500,000 tons in FY '28.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Ferrochrome output is expected to be broadly 400,000 tons in FY27.

lab.quote: Secondly, as far as our strategy for Kalinganagar 1 and 2 is concerned, our output is going to go from about 265,000 tons, which is where we are in FY '26 to broadly 400,000 tons in FY '27 and 500,000 tons or so, 475,000 to 500,000 tons in FY '28.

call_memory.quote: Secondly, as far as our strategy for Kalinganagar 1 and 2 is concerned, our output is going to go from about 265,000 tons, which is where we are in FY '26 to broadly 400,000 tons in FY '27 and 500,000 tons or so, 475,000 to 500,000 tons in FY '28.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Ferrochrome output is targeted to reach 475,000 to 500,000 tons in FY28.

lab.quote: And FY '27, the target is for 10 lakh tons.

call_memory.quote: And FY '27, the target is for 10 lakh tons.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Chrome ore mining target for FY27 is 10 lakh tons.

lab.quote: Total amount of INR450 crores planned towards capex.

call_memory.quote: Total amount of INR450 crores planned towards capex.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Planned capex for FY27 is approximately INR 450 crores across Kalinganagar, Ethanol projects, and Sukinda underground mines.

lab.quote: We have taken INR470 crores of term loan , which we have partly utilized by March. We have unutilized balance of INR170 crores from there which we will use along with the internal accruals.

call_memory.quote: We have taken INR470 crores of term loan , which we have partly utilized by March. We have unutilized balance of INR170 crores from there which we will use along with the internal accruals.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company has an unutilized sanctioned term loan balance of INR 170 crores from its INR 470 crores facility to fund capex.

lab.quote: We will be taking up pre-commissioning activities in July, as we have mentioned, and commissioning in Q2 of FY '27. We should be able to start getting output maybe towards the end of August or something of that sort.

call_memory.quote: We will be taking up pre-commissioning activities in July, as we have mentioned, and commissioning in Q2 of FY '27. We should be able to start getting output maybe towards the end of August or something of that sort.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Ethanol project pre-commissioning will start in July with commissioning in Q2 FY27 and output towards the end of August.

lab.quote: So, 70 and 65 take the hybrid renewable energy portfolio to 135 megawatts, which will substantially reduce our carbon footprint through abatement of carbon emissions.

call_memory.quote: So, 70 and 65 take the hybrid renewable energy portfolio to 135 megawatts, which will substantially reduce our carbon footprint through abatement of carbon emissions.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Hybrid renewable energy portfolio stands at 135 MW, including 70 MW with JSW Energy starting July 2026 and 65 MW with Enfinity Global coming online June 2027.

call_memory.condition: when full capacity is online and steady-state

lab.quote: Okay. So slight clarification to that, Aashav, which is that when entire KNR complex comprising 1 and 2 is up and running is where we are looking at a weighted average reduction in EBITDA cost by INR3,000 to INR4,000 on account of better logistics.

call_memory.quote: Okay. So slight clarification to that, Aashav, which is that when entire KNR complex comprising 1 and 2 is up and running is where we are looking at a weighted average reduction in EBITDA cost by INR3,000 to INR4,000 on account of better logistics.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The entire KNR complex (KNR 1 and KNR 2) combined is expected to yield a weighted average reduction in EBITDA cost of INR 3,000 to INR 4,000 per ton due to better logistics.

lab.quote: coal sourcing through linkages is also the pricing is going to be about INR400 to INR500 a ton cheaper. So those are some advantages in our existing thermal coal generation that we will see, but from H2 of FY '27.

call_memory.quote: coal sourcing through linkages is also the pricing is going to be about INR400 to INR500 a ton cheaper. So those are some advantages in our existing thermal coal generation that we will see, but from H2 of FY '27.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Pricing under fresh coal linkages being bid for is expected to be about INR 400 to INR 500 a ton cheaper from H2 FY27.

lab.quote: The eventual plan, which is what we are spending that close to INR1,000 crores for is to sustain output at 12 lakh tons per annum and entirely from underground.

call_memory.quote: The eventual plan, which is what we are spending that close to INR1,000 crores for is to sustain output at 12 lakh tons per annum and entirely from underground.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company targets sustaining underground mining output at 12 lakh tons per annum (6 lakh tons each from Mahagiri and Sukinda) with an investment close to INR 1,000 crores.

lab.quote: As you know, KNR 2 has a partially built 33 MVA furnace capable of producing 50,000 tons. We are working on getting environmental clearances for it. And hopefully, by June of 2027 we will have it up and running.

call_memory.quote: As you know, KNR 2 has a partially built 33 MVA furnace capable of producing 50,000 tons. We are working on getting environmental clearances for it. And hopefully, by June of 2027 we will have it up and running.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The partially built 33 MVA furnace in KNR 2 capable of producing 50,000 tons is targeted for commissioning around June 2027.

lab.quote: Whatever we have booked for next 12 to 18 months, under mark to market accounting, we are showing it as a notional forex loss amount, which you see in the investor deck, I have said about INR28 crores of that is actually the notional amount which has been put in.

call_memory.quote: Whatever we have booked for next 12 to 18 months, under mark to market accounting, we are showing it as a notional forex loss amount, which you see in the investor deck, I have said about INR28 crores of that is actually the notional amount which has been put in.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Other expenses in Q4 included a notional mark-to-market forex loss provision of about INR 28 crores due to rupee depreciation, while actual realized loss was only INR 3 crores.

lab.quote: In fact, in the fourth quarter, broadly about 109,000 tons as compared to roughly INR87,000 a ton.

call_memory.quote: In fact, in the fourth quarter, broadly about 109,000 tons as compared to roughly INR87,000 a ton.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Realization in Q4 FY26 was broadly about INR 109,000 per ton compared to roughly INR 87,000 per ton in the corresponding quarter last year.

lab.quote: In fact, currently, I would say domestic prices are in the INR118,000 to INR120,000 a ton mark, which is a little bit higher than what we have seen in Q4 of FY '26.

call_memory.quote: In fact, currently, I would say domestic prices are in the INR118,000 to INR120,000 a ton mark, which is a little bit higher than what we have seen in Q4 of FY '26.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Current domestic ferrochrome prices are at INR 118,000 to INR 120,000 a ton and export realizations are in excess of INR 120,000 a ton.

lab.quote: But broadly, I would say that next fiscal, FY '28, we broadly would expect about 35% to 40% of our total energy consumption to be from renewable sources.

call_memory.quote: But broadly, I would say that next fiscal, FY '28, we broadly would expect about 35% to 40% of our total energy consumption to be from renewable sources.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: In FY28, renewable sources are expected to account for about 35% to 40% of total energy consumption.

lab.quote: As it happens, we are getting the GNA RE corridor from Tata Steel from June 1 onwards and 65 megawatts and 70 megawatts will start flowing from, I would say, July end or so.

call_memory.quote: As it happens, we are getting the GNA RE corridor from Tata Steel from June 1 onwards and 65 megawatts and 70 megawatts will start flowing from, I would say, July end or so.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The GNA RE corridor from Tata Steel is available from June 1 onwards, and 65 megawatts and 70 megawatts will start flowing by around the end of July.

lab.quote: Now secondly, we are looking to participate in some of these critical mineral blocks, which are coming up in Odisha and elsewhere in the country.

call_memory.quote: Now secondly, we are looking to participate in some of these critical mineral blocks, which are coming up in Odisha and elsewhere in the country.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company is looking to participate in critical mineral block auctions in Odisha and elsewhere in India, with plans to become a preferred bidder.

operating_notes.text: Terminated PPA and SSHA with Ampin Energy Utility One for 40 MW hybrid renewable power due to delays, with ₹12.32 Cr investment to be refunded.
Signed 29-year PPA with EG Urja Strot to procure 65 MW hybrid power (81.4 MW solar, 102.6 MW wind, 25 MWh BESS) under captive route via 26% equity stake for ₹110.18 Cr.
Completed acquisition of Tata Steel's Kalinganagar Ferro Chrome Plant on 27 February 2026 for ₹8,610 Cr base consideration plus ₹225.03 Cr net working capital, funded fully through internal accruals.
All furnaces running smoothly in Q1FY27 with approximately 6,000 tons a month output.
Chrome ore inventory built to 6 lakh tons to support increased capacity
Q1FY27 domestic sales at 19%, with flexibility to shift between domestic and export markets

timeline.summary: On May 14, 2026, IMFA terminated its PPA and SSHA with Ampin Energy Utility One for a 40 MW hybrid renewable project and secured a full refund of its ₹12.32 Cr investment.
Entered into 29-year PPA and agreed to acquire 26% stake in EG Urja Strot for ₹110.18 Cr for 65 MW hybrid captive power.
Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share on May 27, 2026, pending shareholder approval.
On 27 May 2026, IMFA fixed the 64th AGM date as 4 August 2026 and record date as 31 July 2026 for final dividend entitlement.
IMFA held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 27, 2026, discussing operational performance and project expansions.
